scope: All games cited across 13 Phase 2 deep JSONs (IG-00..IG-11 + IG-APX)

tiering_criteria.tier_a: cited in ≥3 chapter-units OR sustained-analysis treatment in any one chapter
tiering_criteria.tier_c: cited in 1 chapter-unit, passing or illustrative

tier_a.title: World of Warcraft
tier_a.analytic_move: Primary case-site of the 3-year qualitative research; Ratchet-to-Feathermoon route-planning anchors micro-phase ergodicity; Inauro/Oriel/Aprile interview testimony anchors atmospherics-affective design; Sara Andrews + Austin Texas guild anchor third-place sociality; Ananke's Darkshore swim is the volume's signature self-set-goal exhibit; two-quote disposition contrast operationalizes alterbiography-of-self vs alterbiography-of-entity.
tier_a.interview_evidence: Heavy — Rheric, Kestra, Inauro, Oriel, Aprile, Ananke, Muun are recurring WoW-side anchors of the 25-interview corpus.
tier_a.macro_micro_profile: BOTH heavily — macro (clan work, route-memory, anticipatory raid-attendance, aesthetic mood-regulation) + micro (in-session navigation, end-game guild cooperation, alterbiography-occurrence).

tier_a.title: Planetside
tier_a.analytic_move: Contrasting MMOFPS case-site. Bladerunner 'virtual armies' + Ghosts of the Revolution outfit (Figure 6.3) operationalize mass-scale cooperation; BunkerBoy86 human-vs-AI preference anchors the human-vs-AI distinction; Auraxis spatial-imageability contrast with Azeroth anchors meaningfulness-over-fidelity; Magrider tank + Galaxy air transport anchor multi-axis embodiment vignettes (Kumacho case in IG-10).
tier_a.interview_evidence: Heavy — Bladerunner, BunkerBoy86, Kumacho, Kestra are key PS-side anchors.
tier_a.macro_micro_profile: BOTH — macro (outfit organization, between-session strategy) + micro (large-scale FPS cooperation/competition fusion).

tier_a.title: Counter-Strike: Source
tier_a.analytic_move: Volume's premier multi-dimensional FPS case. IG-04: grenade-throw dissociates agency from intention (Giddens-over-Murray). IG-05 (pp.83-86 + Figures 5.2/5.3): de_dust2 B-rush is the chapter's most detailed worked example. IG-09: 'Monster Kill' exaggerated audio rhetorically amplifies Purpose+Act conjunction (strongest in-chapter Burke-pentad-mapping site). IG-10: spatial+kinesthetic-cornerstone failure case (new-player double-door fumbling).
tier_a.interview_evidence: Moderate — referenced in clan-formation arc with Rambusch et al. 2007.
tier_a.macro_micro_profile: MICRO-dominated; macro present as clan-formation arc.

tier_a.title: Half-Life 2
tier_a.analytic_move: Pre-PIM paradigm of the virtual-game-environment unit-of-analysis (IG-01 sustained treatment); IG-03 p.44 high-spatial contrast against Pong; IG-05 navigation-mastery worked example; IG-06 ergodic-multiplayer substrate.

tier_a.title: The Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion
tier_a.analytic_move: IG-03 p.44 high-spatial contrast; IG-05 Figure 5.4 indexical-to-inhabited shift; IG-07 Uriel-Septim-escape is the scripted-to-open-world paradigm + in-world-books pull-narrative + Redguard/Breton representation-without-simulation alterbiography; IG-09 Cyrodill primary-goal-with-cascading-subgoals.
tier_a.macro_micro_profile: BOTH (single-player but with substantial macro-phase character-development planning).

tier_a.title: Grand Theft Auto IV
tier_a.analytic_move: IG-07 pp.117-119 extended Nico/Roman/Michelle alterbiography walkthrough (chapter's anchor cybertextual-alterbiography example) + Sam Houser Edge designer testimony. IG-06 Dimitri-Rascalov-betrayal operationalizes media-equation cohabitation (AI-only co-presence grounds shared involvement). IG-09 premier ludic case-study across full rewards-typology.

tier_a.title: Tetris
tier_a.analytic_move: Calleja's signature counter-paradigm. IG-02 central to Salen+Zimmerman Tetris-immersibility critique. IG-04 single-miniature-control with multi-dim micro-attention. IG-10 IMPLICIT FOIL — fails the spatial+kinesthetic cornerstone (no habitable space, no avatar-located embodiment) — therefore involvement but NOT incorporation. Strongest discriminator-of-incorporation case in the volume.

tier_a.title: Empire: Total War
tier_a.analytic_move: IG-03 pp.37-38 PEDAGOGICAL FULCRUM of the macro/micro distinction; IG-04 Figure 4.1 simultaneous-miniature command paradigm (up to 20 multi-miniature units); IG-05 p.91 Portugal+Silesia simultaneity = distributed-agency miniature paradigm.

tier_a.title: Bioshock
tier_a.analytic_move: IG-07 pp.123, 132-133 + Figure 7.3. Two roles: (a) paradigmatic PULL NARRATIVE — tape recorders / audio diaries strewn through Rapture as designer-embedded pull elements; (b) paradigmatic SCRIPTED-NARRATIVE-becomes-ALTERBIOGRAPHY — Dr. Steinman foreshadowing primes the player so the surgery-encounter is absorbed into alterbiography. Newly elevated to Tier-A per Phase 2 finding.

tier_a.title: Max Payne
tier_a.depth_of_treatment: sustained-analysis (Tier-A by sustained-analytic role despite 2-unit count)
tier_a.analytic_move: IG-04 Figure 4.4 bullet-time / fantasy-realization (Neo-fantasy externalized as designed exception). IG-07 anti-Juul demonstration that scripted narrative supports flashback/flashforward; paradigm of ALTERBIOGRAPHY OF ENTITY (third-person disposition).

tier_a.title: Mirror's Edge
tier_a.analytic_move: IG-04 Figure 4.5 — parkour-inspired reward structure for perfect-timing momentum recodes obstacles as (generic, non-Gibson) 'affordances' for fluid motion. Strongest single illustration of movement-fluency as pleasure peak of kinesthetic involvement. Anchor for the Phase 0 Gibson-affordance non-attribution finding.

tier_a.title: FIFA 2009 (and FIFA 09 Ultimate Team sub-mode)
tier_a.analytic_move: IG-03 p.49 non-navigable stadium-stands refute magic-circle-as-spatial-marker; IG-04 Figure 4.2 avatar/miniature oscillation paradigm; IG-06 living-room spectatorship case operationalizes spectatorship-as-cohabitation; IG-09 Ultimate Team is the MOST elaborated design-economy analysis in the ludic chapter (strategy/tactics/microtactics + ludic-economy worked example).
tier_a.macro_micro_profile: BOTH (Ultimate Team has heavy macro-phase economy management).

tier_b.role: sniper-readiness-to-act paradigm (IG-03 Figure 3.2); historical-accuracy affect-design vs Medal of Honor Hollywood-pastiche (IG-08); suppressing-fire mechanic-as-designed-affect

tier_b.title: Medieval II: Total War
tier_b.role: distributed-miniature command extension of Empire pattern

tier_b.title: Call of Duty IV / Modern Warfare
tier_b.role: capture-the-flag ergodic-vs-non-ergodic semiosis (IG-09 — strongest Uexküll Wirkmal candidate in volume); clan-formation arc (IG-06)

tier_b.title: F.E.A.R.
tier_b.role: adaptive-AI alertness generator + horror-sequence cross-dimensional amplification (IG-08 pp.5053-5085)

tier_b.title: Left 4 Dead 2
tier_b.role: dynamic-affect-modulation via adaptive 'director' + Hunter cooperative-panic; dual-sourcing thesis

tier_b.title: Medal of Honor: Allied Assault
tier_b.role: unicursal-corridor + invisible-wall worked example (IG-05); Hollywood-pastiche affect-design

tier_b.title: Pong
tier_b.role: low-spatial-involvement contrast case; Wittgensteinian distribution argument

tier_c.title: EVE Online (incl. Guiding Hand Social Club heist)
Magrider tank + Galaxy air transport (Planetside subsystems)

aggregate_observations: WoW is sui generis (only game cited across all 9 chapter-units that admit per-game citation); empirical-methodological backbone of the volume.
Planetside is the second backbone (8 units); WoW+Planetside form the binary comparative scaffold per IG-APX P-018.

Stratification key: Tetris = involvement-without-incorporation (no cornerstone); CS:S = incorporation-when-cornerstone-internalized; WoW = sustained-incorporation across all six dimensions; tabletop = potential-incorporation despite low-fidelity (per IG-10 anti-fidelity argument).

Genre distribution: MMORPG (heavy), MMOFPS (Planetside-dominant), competitive FPS (heavy in micro-phase), narrative FPS (Bioshock, HL series), open-world action (GTA IV, Oblivion, Fallout 3), strategy (Total War series), sports (FIFA, GT), puzzle (Tetris), parkour (Mirror's Edge), aesthetic (Flower).
Notable absences: Dark Souls family, Minecraft, MOBAs, post-2011 titles.
